item.title: US Army Doubles Down on Tactical Cyber with Second Expeditionary Battalion
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The US Army is doubling its expeditionary cyber and EW footprint. A brand-new replica of the 11th Cyber Battalion is standing up in months to push non-kinetic effects straight to the tactical edge.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The new unit is slated to begin standing up in earnest within the coming months and will reach initial operating capability within a year. [SPLIT] ⚡ The pioneering 11th Cyber Battalion currently operates under Joint Task Force–Southern Border, delivering RF-enabled cyber effects to division commanders. item.title: IAF's Orbital Sentinel: GSAT-7C Secures India's Air Power Future
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
India's IAF is set to revolutionize its operational effectiveness with the indigenous GSAT-7C satellite. This dedicated orbital asset will provide secure, beyond-line-of-sight communications, fortifying India's strategic autonomy & deterrence across South Asia. #IndianAirForce #G
[SPLIT] ⚡ The satellite's integration with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs) enables secure, flexible, and resilient beyond-line-of-sight (BLoS) connectivity critical for modern air warfare. [SPLIT] ⚡ This indigenous development by NSIL/ISRO significantly advances India's Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative in critical space-based defense infrastructure.
